summary: Blue Mountain lookout, Kern County: planned in 1936, a station in 1940, a 1953 fire report from the lookout. FFLA lists the enclosed tower gone; no site description found.

facts.status_note: Listed as an enclosed tower that is gone; no source describes what remains.

events.note: Newspaper reported two lookout stations would be erected, one in the Blue Mountain area on the Tulare-Kern county line
Bakersfield paper mentioned the new lookout station on Blue Mountain
E.R. Preston reported the Blue Mountain fire from the lookout station
Blue Mountain fire burned about 1,280 acres of oak trees, grass and brush; reported under control

notes_for_editor: The FFLA California list has three Blue Mountain entries (Calaveras, Kern, Modoc); this story covers only the Kern one at 35.75994, -118.75949, and the record's enclosed_tower kind matches FFLA's Encl. Tower. The newspaper items come through the Forest Lookouts page that quotes them; originals were not checked. A web search snippet describing a 1935 Forest Service tower near Woody was traced to a geocache (GCQBEX) for a Blue Mountain in Montana, so it is disregarded. No construction date, removal date or site description was found. Staffing is known only for 1953.
